topic: Someone finds their college application essay published as an example
text: Wandering through the hall of the library, my fingers traced the spines of books, each one a world I’d visited in quieter times. It was then, in a quiet corner where papers from past students were displayed—inspiration for the next wave of young minds—that I saw it. My college application essay, my thoughts, my words, neatly framed and showcased as an example. The paper felt familiar beneath my gaze, yet there was a distance, a shift in perspective. It was like finding a letter I’d written to myself, now finding its way into the hands of strangers, a part of my journey now guiding others. The sun filtered through the windows, casting long, warm shadows, and in that light, my words seemed to belong, not just to me, but to anyone who needed them.
